cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: About the reunion: don't file me under late because of traffic. I was outside for half an hour. Please let me explain it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat. I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the wrong conclusion. I wanted that seat. I saw you laughing with everyone and couldn't make myself come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was telling them about our camping trip. I wanted you there to finish the story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I owe you a correction: I thought you'd have a better evening without me. Please don't just say that's silly. Can you sit with me while I tell you how long I've thought it?
